g.text: SCR10 — Action required
Kotlin Compose screen definition · FR-KT-03 / no fabricated readiness · blueprint2.0 design only
Service Error (desired running) · MCP error · ADB offline · view stale · catalog quarantined · ARC disabled · 10
Phone390dp: Single-column scrolling data/detail and48dp controls; preserve explicit draft fields on rotation. Modal drawer below840dp; persistent rail
at840dp+. Back returns previous detail, with Discard/Stay for dirty drafts. Landscape: Same IDs and authorization; wide layout only when available
width>=840dp; never shrink protected actions below48dp.
SCR10.C01 · Review prerequisites
Fields: Notification permission/channel,FGS eligibility,debugging enrollment or store repair
Open the precise Android prerequisite page or local help named by sanitized failure
Failure: Returning does not retry or grant; owner must choose explicit eligible Start/Refresh
SCR10.C02 · Return to dashboard
Fields: Actual listener/backend readiness and last reason
Return SCR01 preserving desired state and failed health tuple
Failure: Error cannot be replaced by Running merely by navigation
SCR10.C03 · Open navigation
Fields: SCR01..SCR08,SCR10,SCR11; protected review only via exact command
Open all local destinations through phone drawer or wide rail; Back returns previous screen
Failure: Dirty draft requires Discard/Stay; navigation never commits configuration
SCR10.C04 · Open catalog import
Fields: Current catalog identity/reason and safe expected manifest selection
Open SCR03 import flow when catalog missing/quarantined
Failure: Quarantined imported bytes are never queried as trusted data
SCR10.C05 · Inspect failure reason
Fields: Android15/API35 reference,build/profile/eligibility and sanitized reason
Inspect exact failure facet and permitted next action
Failure: No universal permission fix or blind retry; unavailable evidence stays unknown
SCR10.C06 · Retry safe observation or start
Fields: Current desired state/profile and original failure ID
Retry the explicitly selected safe startup/observation after prerequisite correction
Failure: Reevaluates eligibility/authority; cannot repeat uncertain device mutations
State definitions — exact enabled/disabled controls, effects and recovery
SCR10.S0 · Action required: failed health facet
Disabled: none; owner/backend exact command checks remain
Effect: Service Error, MCP error, catalog quarantine and stale view shown independently.
Recovery: Inspect exact reason; permitted recovery is explicit and scoped.
SCR10.S1 · Catalog absent/quarantined
Disabled: SCR10.C06
Effect: No device admission; old imported bytes are not trusted.
Recovery: Open catalog import; only independently verified replacement can activate.
SCR10.S2 · Backend disconnected: facts unknown
Disabled: none; owner/backend exact command checks remain
Effect: Backend not connected; unavailable observation is not proof of removed API.
Recovery: Inspect paired profile and safe reconnect; never replay uncertain invocation.
SCR10.S3 · Cancelled recovery: desired Stopped
Disabled: SCR10.C06
Effect: No auto-restart or retry; previously committed config remains.
Recovery: Return dashboard then explicitly Start when eligible.
SCR10.S4 · Prerequisite fixed: safe retry available
Disabled: none; owner/backend exact command checks remain
Effect: Show exact safe observation/start that will be attempted, not a device mutation.
Recovery: Retry reevaluates all gates; failure returns to the reason page.
